title: When the Detention Falls
author: Rosalind Sterling
blurb: Kestrel Blackwood, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
